deploy-bot: preflight checks for release r-2026-03-21-rc1

deploy-bot: quick summary: smoke tests OK, canary latency steady overall, but eu-west embeds route and kvcache show anomalous signals:
- e2e: PASS
- canary p95: 62ms -> 64ms (+3%)
- eu-west embeddings 5xx: 0.07% -> 2.1% (last 10m)
- kv-cache tail p95: 8ms -> 160ms (last 5m)

Suggested action: hold full ramp, pin version in eu-west, investigate kvcache GC and connection churn.

maria (platform): :eyes: pulling dashboards now

sam (oncall): link to the eu-west dashboard?

observability-bot: eu-west embeds dash: https://grafana.redwood/d/embeds-eu-west?from=now-30m (panels: 5xx, p95, kvcache)

natalie (sre): i'm seeing correlated redis eviction spikes on the same host pool — likely GC/eviction cascade. logs show repeated `OOM`-adjacent evictions at 03:12-03:18 UTC

ryan (releases): i'd rather pin and do a staggered ramp. plan: pin rc1 in eu-west, start traffic at 10% -> 50% over 30m if stable.

maria (platform): can we scope the pin to eu-west only?

ryan (releases): yes, region-scoped pin supported.

maria (platform): commands to run:
```
# pin version in eu-west and start slow ramp
deployctl pin --region eu-west --version r-2026-03-21-rc1
deployctl route --region eu-west --weight 10%
```

sam (oncall): if 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 10m in eu-west, we'll trigger a partial rollback.

natalie (sre): agree. also add a temporary circuit-breaker on embeds-route to fail fast and reduce downstream pressure.

ryan (releases): running the pin now.

deploy-bot: executed: `pin` -> success. traffic for r-2026-03-21-rc1 set to 10% in eu-west.

maria (platform): :thumbsup: i'll watch p95 and kvcache tail. shadowing logs for the next 20m.

observability-bot: temporary alert rule created: `eu-west-embeds-5xx-temp` -> fires at 0.5% 5xx sustained for 10m. Notifications -> #eng-oncall + pager.

sam (oncall): ack. i'll be standing by to execute rollback if it trips.

natalie (sre): if it keeps flaring, partial rollback command (5% step) is:
```
deployctl rollback --region eu-west --percent 5
```

ryan (releases): we'll reassess at +5m and +20m. If stable at +30m, continue ramp.

maria (platform): adding a short note to the release changelog: "eu-west pinned to r-2026-03-21-rc1 pending kvcache investigation; staggered ramp initiated."

sam (oncall): closing the loop here — will update thread if alerts fire. target follow-up in 30m.

deploy-bot: thread automated note: preflight hold + region pin applied. Monitoring hooks active.
